target.title: refactor(plugins): trim path safety facade
target.body:
Related: #105595

## What Problem This Solves

The unused-export ratchet still carried ten plugin-local path-safety aliases that no plugin code imports.

## Why This Change Was Made

Remove only the redundant aliases from the internal plugin facade, retain the four helpers with real plugin consumers, and regenerate the full Linux Knip baseline. The regeneration also records three newly reportable pairing exports from current `main`.

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior or public API change. The dependency check now enforces a smaller unused-export baseline: 5,626 entries.

## Evidence

- Full Linux baseline regeneration: `pnpm deadcode:exports:update` produced 5,626 entries; SHA-256 `805c9163c617afd45428c604855c061b9e838feb787f2d22f82a4b2b19d78feb` matched the committed file byte-for-byte.
- Ratchet verification: `pnpm deadcode:exports` matched 5,626 entries.
- Touched-surface gate: `pnpm check:changed` passed, including formatting, plugin SDK API baseline, core and test typechecks, lint, package guards, database-first guards, import cycles, and webhook/pairing guards.
- Fresh post-rebase autoreview: clean, no actionable findings (0.87 confidence).
- Testbox proof: `tbx_01kxcmcwky5wc2zcjhzkn2jqjm` ([Actions run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29219305428)).

## AI Assistance

- Assisted: yes.
- Transcript: not included pending author opt-in.
